tickets.visual_thesis: Synthetic warehouse: a returned parcel enters the inspection lane before it can return to stock.
tickets.takeaway: A return must be checked before it becomes sellable stock.

hero.action: Travel through a scanner and stop at inspection mark

layers.foreground: Actor hands where contact requires it; captions in screen space

camera.action: Track lateral belt travel, then lock for inspection

actor.occlusion: Host above environment, protected from hero collision
actor.reason: Host points out inspection as the bottleneck

motion.settle: Decelerate into the destination with one contact owner
motion.overlap: Background lags the hero; captions remain on their own source clock
